figurative_meaning_en: To reach the end of one's lifespan
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার দিন ফুরিয়েছে, এখন কোনো আশা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: His days are numbered; there's no hope left.
In old age, one feels their days are ending.
history: Referenced in Rabindranath Tagore's poem 'Bakul Badal Sandhya', evoking themes of life's transience.
note: Deeply embedded in Bengali poetic tradition, symbolizing inevitable mortality.
